title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
description: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

title: Prem Rog
description: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
description: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart.

title: Jaat
description: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Saturday Blockbuster Club- Jawan
description: (Movies @6) A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Good Newwz
description: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Sikandar
description: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
description: In an arranged marriage, failed cricketer Mahendra and doctor Mahima bond over their shared nickname, Mahi, and their love for cricket, inspiring her to pursue her dreams.

title: Double Dhamaal
description: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
description: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Pardes
description: (Air India - Around The World) Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Pati Patni Aur Who Do
description: Chintu Tyagi finds his quiet marriage to Vedika thrown into complete chaos when a vibrant young fashion designer named Tapasya enters his world and steals his heart.

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
description: (Movies @6) When family planning disagreements end their marriage, Jas finds love abroad, but hidden secrets and tangled relationships soon complicate his new beginning.

title: UK TV Premiere- Tu Meri Main Tera Tu Meri
description: Two souls discover each other and fall deeply in love, but family pressures force them apart. They part with heavy hearts, holding on to the hope of meeting again someday.
